meta.command_name: RSpec, RSpec (subprocess: 1)-0, RSpec (subprocess: 2)-1, RSpec (subprocess: 3)-2, RSpec (subprocess: 4)-3, RSpec (subprocess: 5)-4, RSpec (subprocess: 6)-5, RSpec (subprocess: 7)-6, RSpec (subprocess: 8)-7

source: # Only allow modern browsers supporting webp images, web push, badges, import maps, CSS nesting, and CSS :has.
# Changes to the importmap will invalidate the etag for HTML responses
format.html { redirect_to root_path, alert: "You are not allowed to do that." }
before_action :set_citizen, only: %i[ show edit update destroy ]
format.html { redirect_to @citizen, notice: "Citizen was successfully created." }
format.html { redirect_to @citizen, notice: "Citizen was successfully updated.", status: :see_other }
format.html { redirect_to citizens_path, notice: "Citizen was successfully destroyed.", status: :see_other }
format.html { redirect_to @citizen, alert: "A citizen with consent history cannot be deleted." }
# Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
# verified is an admin decision. A citizen cannot mark themselves verified.
cookies.signed.permanent[:session_id] = { value: session.id, httponly: true, same_site: :lax }
redirect_to consents_path, notice: "Consent was successfully destroyed.", status: :see_other
redirect_to @consent, alert: "A consent with history cannot be deleted."
# Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
# The citizen is always the signed-in user. granted_at and revoked_at are history.
rate_limit to: 10, within: 3.minutes, only: :create, with: -> { redirect_to new_password_path, alert: "Try again later." }
redirect_to new_session_path, notice: "Password reset instructions sent (if user with that email address exists)."
redirect_to new_session_path, notice: "Password has been reset."
redirect_to edit_password_path(params[:token]), alert: "Passwords did not match."
redirect_to new_password_path, alert: "Password reset link is invalid or has expired."
rate_limit to: 10, within: 3.minutes, only: :create, with: -> { redirect_to new_registration_path, alert: "Try again later." }
before_action :set_service, only: %i[ show edit update destroy ]
format.html { redirect_to @service, notice: "Service was successfully created." }
format.html { redirect_to @service, notice: "Service was successfully updated.", status: :see_other }
format.html { redirect_to services_path, notice: "Service was successfully destroyed.", status: :see_other }
format.html { redirect_to @service, alert: "A service with consent history cannot be deleted." }
# Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
# Only allow a list of trusted parameters through.
rate_limit to: 10, within: 3.minutes, only: :create, with: -> { redirect_to new_session_path, alert: "Try again later." }
redirect_to new_session_path, alert: "Try another email address or password."
# Automatically retry jobs that encountered a deadlock
# Most jobs are safe to ignore if the underlying records are no longer available
mail subject: "Your consent for #{consent.service.name} has expired", to: consent.citizen.email
mail subject: "Reset your password", to: user.email_address
validates :service_id, uniqueness: { scope: :citizen_id, message: "already has consent from this citizen" }
enum :action, { granted: "granted", revoked: "revoked", expired: "expired" }, validate: true
# Append-only. A saved event cannot be edited or deleted.
enum :role, { citizen: "citizen", admin: "admin" }, default: :citizen, validate: true
# Consents are never edited: revoke and grant a new one instead.
# A revoked consent can't be revoked again, so its revoked_at never changes.
# Narrows a consent scope by status, service, and a name search.
# Revoke is a person choosing to take a consent back. The expiry job does not
# come through here: it writes an "expired" event with no user.
